name: ws-marketplace
description: WS Agency internal plugins, agents, and tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: docs-agent
plugins.description: Dual-track documentation suite with unified /ws-docs entry (discovery, init, audit, catchup, repair, write, adr, architecture, contributing, changelog, release-notes), opt-in PreToolUse/Stop hooks, and background subagent dispatch

plugins.name: ws-commit-commands
plugins.description: Jira-aware git workflows: Conventional Commits with ticket suffix, Smart Commit worklogs, automatic Keep-a-Changelog updates, PR creation via tea (Gitea), and Jira OAuth onboarding

plugins.name: ws-jira-enhancer
plugins.description: Transform brief task descriptions into well-structured Jira tickets

plugins.name: ws-claude-sync
plugins.description: Sync Claude Code contexts, settings, and sessions across machines via GitHub

plugins.name: ws-clamp
plugins.description: Move, archive, fix, and manage Claude Code projects while preserving session history

plugins.name: ws-project-hub
plugins.description: Multi-repo project hub: single source of truth for projects spanning multiple git repos (app, web, design, docs) with auto-generated CLAUDE.md and Claude launch script
